description:
Edit repos/identity-vessel/src/index.ts and no other file.

In the handler registered at app.post("/v1/keys/revoke"), after the existing revokeKey() call succeeds, add an UPDATE against SurrealDB that sets is_active = false on the api_key row for the revoked key_id, using the same query helper that app.get("/v1/keys") imports with: const { query } = await import("./db/surrealdb").

Why: revokeKey() lives in db/redis.ts and only does redis.setex("revoked:" + keyId, ttl, "1"). The listing handler reads SurrealDB and derives status from r.is_active, so nothing ever marks the row inactive and a revoked key is listed as active forever. Measured: after a successful revoke, /v1/keys/validate correctly returns valid:false "API key has been revoked", while substrate-key list still shows that key active.

Constraints: change only repos/identity-vessel/src/index.ts. Do not modify db/redis.ts, db/surrealdb.ts, services/discovery-client.ts, or any import statement in any file. Do not change the validate path. A previous attempt was rolled back because it also rewrote an unrelated import in services/discovery-client.ts to a package that does not exist.
